annotations.title: Spawn or free in the running game

description:
Spawn a scene into the RUNNING game (action spawn) or free a live node (action free) to set up a test. The scene file is not touched. Then check with summer_game_probe.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/runtime-spawn"}

action.description: 'spawn' instantiates a PackedScene under parent (SpawnRuntimeScene); 'free' removes a node (FreeRuntimeNode).

instance.description: Game instance to address (default 'main' = the editor's embedded game).

mode.description: action:'free' — 'queue_free' (default, safe: frees at the end of the frame) or 'free' (immediate).

name.description: action:'spawn' — node name; the engine renames on collision and reports renamed_to.

parent.description: action:'spawn' — ABSOLUTE runtime path of the parent, e.g. '/root/Main/Enemies'.

path.description: action:'free' — ABSOLUTE runtime path of the node to free.

props.description: action:'spawn' — properties set on the new node before it enters the tree ({position: 'Vector3(0, 1, 0)', health: 50}). Unknown ones land in prop_warnings, never fail the spawn.

name: summer_runtime_spawn
